description: Negative test cases for REM-PARITY generation 2 (schema_major 2), groups 7a (sidecar, Section 9), 7b (ParityMap directory and locator, bootstrap payload bounds, terminal Object row, replica scope scalars, role magics) and 7c (checked-arithmetic overflow vectors, Section 2.4). Every expectation is derived from the specification text alone; no implementation, expected-output file or generated case was consulted. Each case names a base artifact, a text-level mutation, the integrity repair that lets the mutation reach its target check, the expected Section 15 outcome, the deciding sentences, and whether the text pins the outcome.
source: remanence/specs/in-progress/rem-parity-1-specification.md (REM-PARITY 1.0.0-draft.5, 2026-09-06); Object-row fields also from rem-object-core-1-specification.md (Section 4.5.1) and rem-encrypt-1-specification.md (Sections 5.2, 5.3)

image_geometry.note: Derived from tape-images/inputs/*.json and tape-images/MANIFEST.tsv with the Section 9.1/9.4/10.1.2 formulas. All images: block size B = 262144 (0x40000), scheme rs-cauchy-gf256-v1, k = 2, m = 2.
image_geometry.a4-minimal: S = 2. file 0 bootstrap (LBA 0); file 1 Object, 4 blocks, ordinals [0,4) (LBA 2); file 2 ParitySidecar epoch 0, range [0,4), real_data_shard_count 4 = S*k (full epoch), P = S*m = 4, H = 1, inline_index_entry_bytes = 4*16 + 4*8 = 96, total = 2H+P+1 = 7, tail copy at block H+P = 5, footer at block 2H+P = 6 (LBA 7..13); file 3 ParityMap, 3 blocks, M = 1 (LBA 15); files 4..8 = A, AB, B, BC, C (3 records each, compact separation E = 3*B); EOD LBA 39.
image_geometry.two-epoch: S = 2. file 1 Object, 8 blocks; file 2 sidecar epoch 0 [0,4) (LBA 11); file 3 sidecar epoch 1 [4,8) (LBA 19); both H = 1, P = 4, total 7, inline 96; file 4 ParityMap (3 blocks, M = 1), directory with two entries naming tape files 2 and 3; files 5..9 terminal suffix; EOD 51.
image_geometry.short-epoch: S = 4. file 1 Object, 2 blocks; file 2 sidecar epoch 0 [0,2), real 2 < logical S*k = 8, P = 8, H = 1, inline = 8*16 + 2*8 = 144, total = 11; file 3 ParityMap; EOD 41.
image_geometry.sidecar_copy_offsets: Within a sidecar header/index copy block (Section 9.2): header 0x00..0xC8; parity entries (16 bytes each, stripe-major) from 0xC8; data-CRC entries (8 bytes each) follow; zero fill to B-8; block0_crc64 at B-8 = 0x3FFF8. For a4-minimal/two-epoch: parity entries 0xC8..0x108 (entry j: u32 stripe at +0, u16 parity_index at +4, u16 reserved at +6, u64 crc at +8), data-CRC entries 0x108..0x128, fill 0x128..0x3FFF8.
image_geometry.terminal_profiles: minimal-{256k,512k,1024k}: prefix = bootstrap only, 1 structural row, 0 Object rows, payload_len 64, A at tape file 1 / LBA 2, EOD 22. multi-{256k,512k,1024k}: 6 structural rows (files 0..5: Bootstrap, Object 2 blk ordinals [0,2), Sidecar epoch 0 [0,2), Object 3 blk ordinals [2,5), Sidecar epoch 1 [2,5), ParityMap 3 blk), 2 Object rows (file 1 plaintext, file 3 encrypted), payload_len = 64*6 + 256*2 = 896, T = W = 5, covered = 6, A at tape file 6 / LBA 25, EOD 45. Every replica and separation file is 3 records: header record at file offset 0, payload record (replica) or zero interior (separation) at offset B, footer record at offset 2B. In multi replicas the payload record holds structural slot i at payload offset 64*i and Object-row slot j at 384 + 256*j.

repair_profiles.R-SC-HASHED: Mutation inside sidecar header bytes 0x00..0x8F or inside an index entry: recompute canonical_metadata_hash (0x98, Section 9.5) over the mutated copy's own bytes, then header_crc64 (0xC0, over 0x00..0xC0), then block0_crc64 (B-8, over 0..B-8). Leave the other copy, the footer and the ParityMap directory entry unchanged unless the case says otherwise.
repair_profiles.R-SC-UNHASHED: Mutation inside 0x90..0xBF other than the hash field (copy_kind, reserved 0x92, copy_generation, reserved 0xB8): these are excluded from the hash (Section 9.5), so recompute header_crc64 (0xC0) and block0_crc64 (B-8) only.
repair_profiles.R-SC-FILL: Mutation in the zero fill of an index block: recompute that block's trailing CRC (B-8) only; fill is outside the header CRC range and outside the hash (entries are hashed 'without block padding').
repair_profiles.R-SC-FOOTER: Mutation in sidecar footer bytes 0x00..0x80: recompute footer_crc64 (0x80). Footer fill (0x88..end) is covered by no CRC and needs no repair.
repair_profiles.R-PM-PAYLOAD: ParityMap payload change applied identically to both copies (primary block 0 and tail block M, payload from offset 0xC8): recompute payload_sha256 (0x38) in the primary header, the tail header and the footer; update payload_len (0x30) in all three if the length changes (keep M unchanged); recompute the CRC-64/XZ at 0xC0 of all three blocks. canonical_map_digest is unaffected (it covers the Section 7.3 projection, not payload bytes). Terminal replicas are unaffected (their structural row for the ParityMap carries only tape file, kind and block count).
repair_profiles.R-PM-FOOTER: ParityMap footer-only change: recompute the footer's CRC-64/XZ at 0xC0.
repair_profiles.R-TR-COMMON: Replica edition-common field change: write the same value in the header record and the footer record; recompute the edition digest (0x0E8) when the field is in its preimage, the terminal-layout digest (0x108) when a component tuple changes, the replica descriptor digest (0x128) in both frames, the header CRC (0x3F8), the footer's complete header-record SHA-256 (0x2B8), and the footer CRC (0x3F8).
repair_profiles.R-TR-PAYLOAD: Replica payload slot change: rewrite the slot as encoded_len:u16 LE || deterministic CBOR || zero padding; recompute the domain-separated payload SHA-256 (0x0A8); if a structural slot changed, recompute the canonical-map SHA-256 (0x0C8); then apply R-TR-COMMON (the edition digest preimage contains payload_sha256 and canonical_map_sha256).
repair_profiles.R-TR-FOOTER-LOCAL: Replica footer-local field change (0x2B8..0x300): recompute the footer CRC (0x3F8) only; the observed fields are in no digest preimage.
repair_profiles.R-SEP: Separation extent header change: write shared fields in both header and footer; recompute the separation descriptor digest (0x0B8) when the field is in its preimage; recompute the header CRC (0x1F8), the footer's header-record SHA-256 (0x180) and the footer CRC (0x1F8).
repair_profiles.R-BOOT-HDR: Bootstrap fixed-frame change inside 0x00..0x30: recompute crc64_header (0x30).

conventions.observation_point: Sidecar cases (7a) are observed at the per-copy validation of a sidecar header/index copy (Sections 9.2-9.5), which the Recoverer runs in index acquisition (Section 13.3) and a Verifier runs over every sidecar (Section 2.2). A finalized tape's inventory Scanner never parses sidecars, so it reports nothing for these cases. When only one copy is mutated, the case's expected error is the outcome for that copy; the tape-level Recoverer consequence is given separately, because Section 13.3 uses the surviving copy. both_copies_escalation: applying the same mutation and repair to the tail copy too leaves no valid header/index copy, and the Recoverer's outcome for that epoch is SidecarMetadataUnavailable{epoch_id} (Section 13.3 step 4, Section 12.5); a Verifier reports SidecarParse for each copy.
conventions.shadowing_rule: A case is marked shadowed only when an earlier check with a DIFFERENT outcome fires first. Concurrent checks that yield the same Section 15 name are listed under concurrent_checks and do not shadow the case, because the text fixes no check order inside a sidecar copy (see NOTES.md).

cases.target: sidecar header/index copy validation, block_size rule (Section 9.2), as run by the Recoverer's index acquisition (Section 13.3) and by a Verifier

expected.permitting_text: Section 9.2 makes the value a per-copy constraint ('MUST equal the actual block size'), which is a Section 9 violation (SidecarParse); Section 13.3 pins the acquired index against the bootstrap's block size with SchemeMismatch, and Section 15 describes SchemeMismatch as 'sidecar geometry disagrees with the bootstrap or supplied scheme'. The same comparison therefore carries two names and the text orders them only for the Recoverer ('The acquired index MUST then be pinned').

cases.tape_level: Recoverer: the primary is invalid, the footer and tail are valid, so the tail copy is used and epoch 0 stays usable (no error). Recomputed H and inline bytes at 524288 are still 1 and 96, so no layout check fires incidentally.
quotes: | 0x28 | 4 | block_size u32 | MUST equal the actual block size |

The acquired index MUST then be pinned against the bootstrap's scheme record (`k`, `m`, `S`, block size), or against the supplied scheme and block size when the bootstrap is unreadable, and against the map entry's ordinal range; disagreement is `SchemeMismatch`.
SidecarParse                    sidecar structure violates Section 9
SchemeMismatch                  sidecar geometry disagrees with the bootstrap or supplied scheme
cases.pin_reason: For the Recoverer the word 'then' puts copy validation (SidecarParse) first, but a Verifier has no such ordering and both Section 15 descriptions fit the same comparison. The informative draft.1 history entry ('Geometry and ordinal-range disagreements raise SchemeMismatch') points the other way.
